app.renderSettings.settings_settings_set:
SETTINGS

Settings

Set up your profile, AI providers, and data preferences.

⟦0⟧Credentials stored in ⟦1⟧

Your profile

The assistant uses this to introduce itself and sign drafts.

⟦6⟧ Local AI (Ollama)

Local inference runs on this Mac when an installed model is available. Install Ollama from ollama.com and choose a model. Recommended development setup: Mac with 24 GB memory and Qwen 3.5 9B or larger. Small models can confuse messages with tasks. Other configured integrations may still use the network.

⟦10⟧ External AI

For more complex tasks. Supports OpenAI, Claude, Grok, Mistral, Gemini, OpenRouter, or an OpenAI-compatible API. Provider pricing applies.

⟦17⟧

⟦18⟧ Fast classification (decision models)

Decision models such as Jev or Clef choose among bounded options and return probabilities. Without a configured decision model, general AI performs classification. Provider pricing applies.

Model names: on TypeSafe, jev-latest. On OpenRouter, typesafe/jev-1.13 or cloudflare/clef-flash. Verify the exact model name with the provider.

⟦24⟧

⟦25⟧ Choose AI provider y privacidad

Automatic uses local AI and falls back to external AI if configured.

When client data goes to external AI

⟦29⟧

External errands are not anonymized. Review the actual recipient and data before approving delivery.

⟦30⟧ Agentes externos

Prepare requests for configured external agents. Manual handoff opens an app; a configured A2A or webhook integration receives an approved request directly. Provider capabilities must be checked separately.

⟦31⟧

Backups

A local backup is saved on startup and every 24 hours. The latest 14 dates are retained; a new same-day backup replaces the earlier one. Keychain credentials are excluded.

⟦34⟧

Checking the latest backup…

Sample data

Load a fictional Spanish insurance brokerage with clients, tasks, classified messages, and proposals for demonstrations. A backup is saved first. This also sets the sample profile name to Laura Medina.

Quit the application
